trap.label: if + would
trap.wrong: If I would have known, I would be there now.
trap.right: If I had known, I would be there now.
trap.why: O português usa subjuntivo (“se eu soubesse”) e o brasileiro traduz com would. Em inglês a oração com if não leva would: use past perfect (passado) ou past simple (presente).

mcq.q: Choose the correct mixed conditional: “If we ___ earlier, we would not be in trouble now.”
mcq.why: Tipo A: past perfect + would + base.

opts: If I would be a mayor, I had fixed it.
If I am a mayor, I would have fixed it.
If I were a mayor, I would have fixed it.
mcq.why: Tipo B: past simple + would have + pp.

opts: If I would have studied, I would be calmer.
If I had studied, I would be calmer.
If I had studied, I might be calmer.
mcq.why: Sem would na oração com if.

fix.wrong: If they would have listened, we would be safer today.
fix.right: If they had listened, we would be safer today.

fix.wrong: If I was a politician, I would have push the law.
fix.right: If I were a politician, I would have pushed the law.

fix.wrong: If she had warned us, we would not facing this now.
fix.right: If she had warned us, we would not be facing this now.

rewrite.prompt: Transforme em condicional mista: “We did not act, so we face this problem now.” (If…)
rewrite.answer: If we had acted, we would not be facing this problem now.
rewrite.why: Ou: would not face — use esta forma.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva sem would na oração com if: “If he would have known, he would have called.”
rewrite.answer: If he had known, he would have called.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com might: “If I had slept, I would be fine now.”
rewrite.answer: If I had slept, I might be fine now.
